body_findings.title: Distinguish sample retirement from saturation scope fence
body_findings.finding: The body says authenticated retirement always fences a known scope. Reviewed SPEC line 534 applies sample-wide refusal normally; lines 558-560 apply the reserved whole-scope fence when detailed cleanup/alias/slot storage cannot be retained. The public summary should preserve that distinction.
body_findings.recommended_text: Withdrawal and retirement restrict monotonically. Authenticated retirement applies sample refusal before payload erasure and does not wait for sequence gaps; saturation uses the reserved scope fence. Acknowledgments remain pending until covered payload is absent.

body_clarity_suggestion.suggestion: Describe existing hosted phone-intake code, to avoid implying production intake is deployed.

other_body_scope_and_evidence_assessment: Accurately labels an unapproved architecture proposal, synthetic local packages, owner-held real sharing/credential/retention, provisional resource bounds, private scientific data, unchanged public agents, and separate production/science gates. Separates static prose evidence from runtime and authored-file scans from a held whole-stack scan.
